theme: Light for User Side, Dark for Admin Side
archetype: User Choice mapped to Archetype 4 (Swiss/Functional Structure)

design_philosophy.vibe: Transactional, clear hierarchy, high-contrast structural design

rules: Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em])
Always set text color on hover explicitly

layout_spacing.topbar: h-[72px] fixed top-0 w-[calc(100%-280px)] ml-[280px] z-40 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-[#1e293b]/80 border-b border-[#e5e7eb] dark:border-[#334155]

micro_themes.user_cards: Flat background (#ffffff), 1px solid border (#e5e7eb), no shadow by default, subtle -translate-y-1 on hover with shadow-sm.
micro_themes.admin_cards: Flat dark background (#1e293b), crisp 1px solid border (#334155), no soft shadows, tactical technical look.
micro_themes.buttons: Primary buttons use solid #7c3aed, hover #8b5cf6. Rounded 8px. Text color always white.
micro_themes.status_badges: High contrast pill shapes, varying border colors based on status (e.g. green for completed, amber for pending, red for cancelled).

components.forms: React Hook Form + Zod, integrated with Shadcn Form. All inputs have 8px radius.
components.tables: Shadcn Table component, left-aligned text, fixed headers
components.crypto_payment_monitor: Live BEP20 payment session with custom QR code component, countdown timer, and real-time status updates via Socket.io.

media.instructions: Use auth_bg_light and auth_bg_dark for login/register split screens. Use avatar_1 and avatar_2 for user profile mockups or admin user lists.

testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color hex codes for the user side (light mode) and admin side (dark mode).
Apply 8px border radius to inputs and 12px to cards.
Implement the live BEP20 payment session page meticulously with a visible countdown, QR code, and real-time waiting state.
Do NOT use transparent headers; use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl and the specified surface color with opacity.
